capabilities: Show Things 3 Today to-dos, deadlines and projects in an Obsidian window
Send note content to Things as a to-do with a link back to the note
Complete, reschedule or move to-dos from Obsidian in the background
Open the note linked to a to-do or show a to-do in Things
Expose an API so other plugins can read lists and create to-dos or projects
disambiguation: Not a to-do manager inside Obsidian; Things 3 stays the single source of truth and the plugin only mirrors and sends tasks.
extras: The window needs a Mac running Things 3; Send to Things works on every platform Things runs on. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later. Reading uses AppleScript (macOS Automation permission), adding uses the Things URL scheme; no network access and to-do text is kept in memory only. Not made by or affiliated with Cultured Code.
motivation: Designed for ADHD and autistic brains: one to-do shown large, sending a to-do takes seconds, and there are no counters or streaks.
problem: Obsidian users who keep tasks in Things 3 must switch between apps, and notes that contain commitments have no link back to their to-dos.

relations.evidence: A Things 3 window in Obsidian, so a task is never far from its note

summary: A Things 3 task window inside Obsidian showing Today, deadlines and projects, with to-dos linked back to notes and a quick send-to-Things draft.
